The [[12-4C-41 traffic control droid]] possessed a sophisticated '''optic/recorder system''' to assist in their duties as a [[Traffic controller/Legends|traffic controller]]. The optic/recorder system was capable of panoramic and macroscopic scans, allowing the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to pinpoint a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] position through [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of thick fog. At the same time, the [[Controller droid/Legends|controller droid]] was able to watch dozens of monitor screens and recording all of the information in its [[Droid brain/Legends|cognitive processor]].<ref name="EGTD" />
